all.src: Total debit <= 4% of equity; total bid-ask across all six legs <= 10% of debit (this is the binding constraint - most candidates fail here).

management.src: Manage per-calendar, not as a blob: close any individual calendar whose short |delta| exceeds 0.70.

exits.src: Close or roll ALL THREE short legs by 14:30 ET on front expiration day, unconditionally.
Close the whole ladder no later than 2 trading days before front expiry if not rolling.
Close any short leg whose extrinsic <= $0.05 or |delta| >= 0.90 immediately.
Short calls: close before ex-dividend if extrinsic < dividend per share.
